summary: Batch 1 (Clarity & Trust) SafeDeal UI/UX programme verified end-to-end on preview. Backend regression (23 tests in test_safedeal_api.py + test_safedeal_iter203.py) is green and GET /api/safedeal/config now returns legal_name='Dynopay Payments Ltd.'. Landing (fee calculator, buyer/seller columns, FAQ, footer, invited CTA, trust strip, mobile no-hscroll, no 'DynoPay' spelling, no language bar), sign-in (reassurance, preview code, 30s resend cooldown w/ data-cooldown, auto-advance/auto-submit, ClipboardEvent paste, wrong-code error, use-different-email, ?invited=1 heading, invite-aware card with locked+unlock email), unauthenticated deal preview (sd-deal-preview + sd-preview-signin next+email), deals list (deadline pills, todo chips only on my move, status glossary tooltip, tabular-nums), deal page next-step banner for every state (invited creator/them, invited invitee/you, funded seller/you, funded buyer/them, delivered buyer/you with 'Auto-releases in Xd Yh · <abs date>', delivered seller/them), mobile sticky bar (release/accept/etc when my move; hidden when theirs), create deal (Inspection period label, sd-new-days-3, sticky desktop quote, mobile sd-new-quote-bar with correct 'Buyer pays $318.30 · Seller gets $300.00' after 300 + toggle aria-expanded + sd-quote-buyer-pays inside), wallet (available caption rgba(255,255,255,0.72), tabular-nums), a11y (1 h1, radiogroup+3 radios, Space toggles split, focus outline 2px solid) — all pass. Three minor issues found: (1) footer legal has a double period ('Ltd..'), (2) sd-deal-status chip on the deal page is not keyboard-focusable (tabindex not set to 0), (3) focus-visible outline color is near-black rgb(10,10,10) instead of the spec'd indigo #4338CA under /safedeal/*.

ui_bugs.issue: Legal line renders 'Operated by Dynopay Payments Ltd.. Not a bank; ...' — double period because a '.' is appended to a legal_name that already ends with '.'
sd-deal-status has no tabindex attribute (spec: tabindex=0 for keyboard focus / glossary reveal). Hover tooltip works; keyboard focus does not surface it.

Computed :focus-visible outline color on /safedeal/* links is rgb(10,10,10) not the spec'd #4338CA (rgb(67,56,202)). outlineStyle=solid, outlineWidth=2px OK; only the color rule appears to be lost/overridden.

issues: Still shows 'Auto-release 3 days after delivery' rather than the Batch-1 'Inspection period' phrasing (spec explicitly required rename on create-deal + delivered banner; preview card left with old wording — minor inconsistency)

action_items: Fix footer legal double-period: SafeDealShell composes 'Operated by <legal_name>.' but config.legal_name already ends with '.'. Strip trailing '.' before appending, or drop the appended period.
Add tabindex={0} to the SdStatusChip on DealPage (sd-deal-status) so keyboard users can trigger the glossary tooltip.
Verify the :focus-visible outline-color rule (#4338CA) in SafeDealShell is actually being applied to focused elements — currently computed color is rgb(10,10,10) on landing anchors.
Optional/consistency: rename 'Auto-release … days after delivery' to 'Inspection period …' on the unauthenticated deal preview card so the Batch-1 vocabulary is consistent everywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: The legal footer bug is caused by concatenating a period onto a value that already ends in one — safer to normalise once (e.g. `legal_name.replace(/\.$/, '')`) and control punctuation in the JSX only.

SdStatusChip works as an interactive tooltip trigger; ensure it exposes role='button' or tabIndex=0 so it is discoverable via keyboard as well as hover (a11y regression risk when the tooltip carries the only 'what does this status mean' copy).

The `:focus-visible` outline colour appears to be overridden globally (MUI/CssBaseline default is near-black). Consider adding `!important` or scoping the CSS higher, and add a Playwright a11y guard so the outline colour doesn't regress silently.

Existing merchant creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md were not needed for SafeDeal.
seed_data_creation: Created three SafeDeal escrows on preview (all seller=A, buyer=B, fee_payer=buyer, auto_release_days=3): deal_token e9e3daf5c3853fd39e6a2734ff49ac6f26f55845574a1814 ('Batch1 invite test', $300, status=invited); 21fb1e633e2da9d8c543c0ea91acc86e1e0c507cbb751855 ('Funded deal', $200, status=funded); 551291db48832991c3aab58c3f6c14d649ca2c29b9e08d98 ('Delivered deal', $150, status=delivered). Left in place for retest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 Batch-1 areas verified. Three minor issues only (footer 'Ltd..', sd-deal-status missing tabindex, focus-visible colour black instead of #4338CA). Preview deal card still says 'Auto-release … after delivery' (spec rename missed). Backend regression 23/23 green — no need to rerun unless controller changes. To re-verify quickly: seed tokens/deals already exist (see seed_data_creation); inject sd_token + sd_user into localStorage instead of full sign-in for speed. Time-based checks not run: (a) 60s 'still nothing?' helper on sign-in, (b) waiting resend cooldown all the way to 0. Wallet human-status label was not exhaustively driven because setting up a withdrawal from a fresh account requires step-up + payout address + withdraw sequence and the plumbing is already covered by existing test_safedeal_iter203.py which is green; the wallet page itself renders with tabular-nums and 0.72 caption contrast as required.
rca_of_the_issue: Footer double period: legal_name in /api/safedeal/config returns 'Dynopay Payments Ltd.' (ends with '.'); SafeDealShell footer template appends another '.' after it, producing 'Ltd..'. Reproduce: open any /safedeal page and inspect [data-testid='sd-footer-legal']. Mitigation: trim trailing period from legal_name before concatenation, or remove the literal '.' after {legalName} in the JSX.
